items.summaryZh: Democracy Lab推进面向广泛政治参与和社会正义的社区参与式研究、教学与实践。其研究活动包括媒介制作实验，以及社区、媒介或教学导向研究项目的创意原型探索。

evidence.quote: The Democracy Lab at UC San Diego is a collective of scholars, community organizers, activists, educators, and practitioners working towards participatory democracy.
The Democracy Lab advances community-engaged research, teaching, and practice focused on broad political participation and social justice.
Democracy Lab is a space that facilitates media-making experimentation in advanced undergraduate production courses as well as in media-oriented graduate research.
Democracy Lab events engage emerging research projects and the prototyping of ideas that explore dimensions of community-engaged, media-based, or teaching-focused research.

items.summaryZh: Howell Lab开发癌症治疗药物，并研究其作用和耐药机制，重点探索用能结合肿瘤干细胞受体的蛋白递送治疗载荷。实验室使用生化、分子和遗传技术、分子克隆、人肿瘤细胞体外实验及小鼠异种移植模型进行临床前研究。
researchQuestions: 如何靶向肿瘤干细胞开发抗癌药物？
肿瘤干细胞如何产生耐药，能否干预这一过程？

evidence.quote: Howell Lab Dr. Howell’s lab develops and tests novel cancer therapeutics and investigates their mechanism of action and resistance using cell, molecular, genetic/genomic and experimental therapeutics tools and techniques.
We use biochemical, molecular and genetic techniques to develop drugs that target tumor stem cells .

Our primary focus is on the use of naturally-occurring protein that bind to receptors on tumor stem cells to carry cargoes that either kill tumor cells directly or make them sensitive to other drugs or immunotherapeutics .
We use molecular cloning techniques to produce novel protein drugs at the Moores Cancer Center and test then against human tumor cell lines in vitro and xenog raft models in mice.
We also investigate the mechanisms by which tumor stem cells become resistant to cancer therapeutics and how this process can be interdicted .
The Howell Lab is a component of the Solid Tumor Therapeutics Program and participates in the Cancer Therapeutics Training Program at the UC San Diego Moores Cancer Center .

items.summaryZh: Environmental Fluid Dynamics Lab研究工程与海洋流动问题，重点考察沿海环境中流动结构如何影响湍流混合和物质输运，尺度从岛屿及陆架延伸到珊瑚礁、海带林和波浪边界层。研究结合实验室实验、数值建模与野外观测，并涉及海洋仪器、波浪能及自主载具技术。
researchQuestions: 沿海流动结构如何影响湍流混合和物质输运？

evidence.quote: Research in the Environmental Fluid Dynamics Lab (EFD Lab; PI: G. Pawlak Tejada) addresses engineering and oceanographic fluid flow problems, with a focus on coastal ocean physics.

Our work examines the role of flow structure in turbulent mixing and mass transport in environmental flows at scales ranging from islands, headlands and continental shelves (kilometers) to coral reefs and kelp forests (meters) to wave boundary layers (centimeters).

Research methods combine lab experiments and numerical modeling with field-based observations to address topics that span interaction of flow with biological systems, surface and internal waves, and air-sea and sediment/water-column exchange processes.
Research directions also extend to development of ocean instrumentation, wave energy and autonomous vehicle technologies and applications and lab experimental methods.
Geno Pawlak Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering / Scripps Institution of Oceanography University of California San Diego

items.summaryZh: Nemati Lab开发分析医疗数据的计算工具和机器学习算法，用于患者表型识别、轨迹跟踪、临床事件预测及治疗策略优化。研究融合信号处理、信息论、控制与优化，构建生理启发模型及序贯决策算法，应用于重症监护、神经科学与精神病学以及可穿戴监测。
researchQuestions: 如何从医疗数据识别患者状态并及时预测不良临床事件？
如何通过模型与序贯决策支持治疗策略优化？

evidence.quote: The Nemati Lab at UC San Diego

Our team is broadly interested in developing computational tools and machine learning algorithms for analysis of medical data, with the goal of phenotyping patients, tracking patients' trajectory, predicting impending events, and optimizing treatment strategies to avoid/mitigate adverse outcomes.

To accomplish these, we bring together concepts and tools from signal processing, information theory, control theory, optimization, and machine learning to design physiologically inspired models and predictive analytic and sequential decision-making algorithms.
Application areas include critical care, computational neuroscience and psychiatry, and wearable technology.

items.summaryZh: Herzik Research Group研究真核细胞内大分子运输的分子机制。研究结合生物物理和结构方法，尤其是冷冻电镜，解析相关结构、动态及其原子层次机制。
researchQuestions: 哪些分子机制控制真核细胞内的大分子运输？

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Herzik Lab! We are part of the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at The University of California, San Diego .
Research in our lab focuses on elucidating the molecular underpinnings that govern macromolecular transport within eukaryotic cells.

In particular, the lab employs innovative biophysical and structural methodologies, including electron cryomicroscopy (cryo-EM), to provide an atomic-level understanding of the structure and dynamics that govern these complex biological processes.

items.summaryZh: Safe Autonomous Systems Lab根据系统与环境的模型和数据，研究可扩展的安全保证与控制策略，使自主系统能够适应意外变化和新信息。研究结合最优控制、动态博弈、机器学习及认知科学，并以理论分析和机器人平台物理测试验证方法。
researchQuestions: 如何使自主系统在环境变化和新信息下保持安全并提高效率？

evidence.quote: The Safe Autonomous Systems Lab

Our lab works to provide scalable safety assurances and control policies based on available models and data about the system and environment. These techniques must be able to quickly adapt to unexpected changes and new information in the autonomous system or the environment.

We use tools from optimal control theory and dynamics games, machine learning, and cognitive science to develop new techniques for safety and efficiency in autonomous systems. These techniques are backed by both rigorous theory and physical testing on robotic platforms.
At UCSD she runs the Safe Autonomous Systems Lab within the Contextual Robotics Institute.

evidence.quote: This is the web site of the Xtreme Materials Laboratory at the University of California San Diego.
Our laboratory focuses on the design, manufacturing and crystallography of materials for applications in extreme environments.
Our focus is broad, and encompasses the study of ceramics (carbides, borides and oxides) and metals.

Currently, we have projects on the design of radiation detectors, materials for ultra-high temperature applications, luminescent ceramics, and biomaterials (particularly hydroxyapatite), among others.

items.summaryZh: Dutton Lab用简化的微生物群落研究物种相互作用和群落形成的基本机制，主要以奶酪微生物群落为模型。实验室建立可培养、构建和操纵的群落实验系统，以识别群落形成的分子机制及其失常过程。
researchQuestions: 哪些机制驱动物种相互作用与微生物群落形成？
群落形成的分子机制发生异常时会怎样？
methods: 实验室群落构建与操纵

evidence.quote: The Dutton Lab is located at UC San Diego in beautiful La Jolla, California. We are part of the Section of Molecular Biology, in the Division of Biological Sciences .
To address this challenge, our lab has taken the approach of using simplified microbial communities as model systems.

The goal of our work is to understand the basic mechanisms that are at play within microbial communities, such as those that drive species interactions, and to identify general principles of community formation.

Our model system of choice is cheese. The microbial communities of cheese are relatively simple, easily culturable, rich in species interactions, and undergo reproducible dynamics of community assembly.

Our previous work has focused on establishing an experimental system for building, manipulating, and studying these communities in the lab. We are now working to capitalize on this experimental system to identify molecular mechanisms that are responsible for the formation of a microbial community, and to better understand what happens when this process goes wrong.
